# Dre Dev Tools

> Free browser calculators for HVAC techs, electricians, floor coating installers, pool techs, bakers and soap makers, plus the Dre Dev phone apps they come from. Numbers come from published tables (refrigerant PT data, NEC 310.16, IEC); formulas match the apps. No account, no ads, no tracking cookies.

Made by Andrii Zhukovskyi, an independent developer: https://zhukovskyi.space/ . Support: mobile.support@zhukovskyi.space. Apps work offline and keep data on the phone.

## Calculators

- [Superheat & subcooling calculator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/superheat-subcooling-calculator.html): R-454B, R-32, R-410A, R-22 with PT lookup.
- [Refrigerant PT charts](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/index.html): 22 refrigerants, bubble and dew columns.
- [Voltage drop calculator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/electrical/voltage-drop-calculator.html): AWG or mm², copper or aluminum, minimum size for 3 %.
- [Epoxy coverage calculator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/coating/epoxy-coverage-calculator.html): Gallons and kits from area, mils and solids.
- [Wire size calculator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/electrical/wire-size-calculator.html): NEC 310.16 conductor and breaker, with voltage drop.
- [AWG to mm² converter](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/electrical/awg-to-mm2.html): AWG and kcmil to mm² and back.
- [Pool chemical calculator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/pool/pool-chemical-calculator.html): Chlorine, baking soda, stabilizer and salt doses.
- [Baker's percentage calculator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/bread/bakers-percentage-calculator.html): Sourdough flour, water, starter and salt.
- [Lye calculator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/soap/lye-calculator.html): NaOH and water for cold process soap.
- [Days until Christmas](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/countdown/christmas-countdown.html): Live countdown to Christmas and New Year.

## Refrigerant PT charts

Pressure-temperature tables with bubble and dew columns: [R-410A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-410a.html), [R-454B](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-454b.html), [R-32](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-32.html), [R-22](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-22.html), [R-134a](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-134a.html), [R-404A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-404a.html), [R-407C](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-407c.html), [R-407A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-407a.html), [R-448A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-448a.html), [R-449A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-449a.html), [R-452A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-452a.html), [R-513A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-513a.html), [R-1234yf](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-1234yf.html), [R-507A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-507a.html), [R-427A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-427a.html), [R-408A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-408a.html), [R-409A](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-409a.html), [R-290](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-290.html), [R-600a](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-600a.html), [R-744](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-744.html), [R-717](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-717.html), [R-12](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/hvac/pt-chart/r-12.html).

## Apps

- [HVAC Charge: Superheat & PT](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/hvac-charge.html): Superheat, subcooling and PT charts for R-454B, R-32, R-410A and more. Offline, no account. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [Electrician Calc: Wire & Panel](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/electrician-calc.html): Wire size, voltage drop, panel planner and 21 electrical calculators. NEC and IEC 60364. Status: coming soon.
- [CoatCalc: Epoxy Floor Coating](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/coatcalc.html): Epoxy and polyaspartic floor calculator: kits, flake, dew point and PDF quotes. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [Days Until: Countdown Widget](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/days-until.html): Countdown widgets for Christmas, trips, birthdays and weddings. Count up from any date, too. Status: coming soon.
- [Focus Sprint: ADHD Timer](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/focus-sprint.html): An ADHD-friendly focus timer: tiny sprints, a kind buddy and a soft app shield. No guilt. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [Water Buddy: Drink Reminder](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/water-buddy.html): A cute water tracker: fill up Buddy, hit your daily goal, unlock outfits and keep your streak. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [Fastwise: Fasting Tracker](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/fastwise.html): Intermittent fasting made simple: a plan that fits you, a live timer and help when hunger hits. Status: coming soon.
- [PoolPro: Chemistry & Route](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/poolpro.html): Pool chemical calculator: exact doses for the products you own, CSI, a test log and a service route. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [SoftWash Pro: Mix & Quote](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/softwash.html): Soft wash calculator: SH mix ratios, downstream strength, chemical cost and PDF quotes. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [RoofCalc: Roofing Calculator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/roofcalc.html): Roofing calculator: squares from the footprint and pitch, every material and PDF quotes. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [SlabCalc: Concrete & Rebar](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/slabcalc.html): Concrete calculator: cubic yards and bags, rebar, mesh and forms on a feet-inch keypad. Pay once, no ads. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [PaintBid: Painting Estimator](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/paintbid.html): Painting estimator: rooms, gallons, labor hours and PDF quotes. Works offline. Status: coming soon.
- [SiteLog: Daily Report & Snags](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/sitelog.html): Daily site reports and punch lists with photos. A PDF in one tap. Works offline. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [Lye Calc: Soap Recipes](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/lye-calc.html): Lye calculator for soap making: NaOH, KOH, superfat, water, soap qualities and batch cost. Status: free closed test on Google Play, App Store coming.
- [Leben in Deutschland: тест UA](https://andronaft.github.io/dredev-tools/apps/leben-in-deutschland.html): Офіційні питання BAMF для тесту Leben in Deutschland з перекладом і поясненнями українською. Без реклами. Status: coming soon.
